description.label: Description
description.value:
With absolute commitment to all righteous merits, I conduct my affairs with straightforward goodness, ever-striving to free myself from moral captivity, with liberty from the shackles of worldly attachment, and only the utmost dedication to my duty to the Lady.

Choose one Troth. Channelling, ingredients, and lore effects for @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-journals.JournalEntry.szhETavVooj84NXa.JournalEntryPage.n0mJrnlLoreGrail]{Lore of the Grail} use this Wind: Ghur (Lore of Beasts). Changing Troth is not offered.
